Hoogerheide

Sunday 24 January 2027

The grand finale of the UCI Cyclo-cross World Cup takes place in Hoogerheide, the Netherlands, on Sunday 24 January. As per usual, the final decisions regarding the overall standings will be made at this final round. Last year, Puck Pieterse and Mathieu van der Poel took the honours. Who will follow in their footsteps and round off the season in style?

Practical information

Address

Scheldeweg - Onderstal Hoogerheide

 

Website local organisation

Visit the website of the local organisation [here](https://www.gpadrievanderpoel.nl/).

 

Do you have a question?

Contact the organisation [here](https://www.ucicyclocrossworldcup.com/en/contact).

How to get there?

By bike

A bicycle parking area is available in Raadhuisstraat in Hoogerheide, close to the church.

 

By bus

From Bergen op Zoom, take bus line 360 or 361 towards Hoogerheide. Get off at the Zandfort stop or at the temporary stop in Duinstraat.

 

By train

Travel to Bergen op Zoom railway station and take bus line 360 or 361 towards Hoogerheide. Get off at the Zandfort stop or at the temporary stop in Duinstraat.

 

By car

From Belgium – Antwerp: follow the A12/A4 towards Bergen op Zoom and take exit 30 (Hoogerheide – Ossendrecht – Putte). Then follow the signs to Hoogerheide and subsequently the "UCI World Cup" signs.

From the north (Rotterdam): take the new A4 towards Vlissingen/Bergen op Zoom and exit at junction 30. From there, follow the "UCI World Cup" signs.

From the east (Breda): follow the A58 towards Bergen op Zoom/Vlissingen and take exit 30. Continue via Hoogerheide, following the "UCI World Cup" signs.

From the west (Goes): take the A58 towards Bergen op Zoom, exit at junction 30 and follow the signs to the course.

 

Parking

After exit 30, clear directional signs will guide you to the designated parking areas.

 

Parking for people with reduced mobility

Haviksberg, Hoogerheide. From exit 30 (Hoogerheide), follow the white directional signs marked "Invaliden parkeerplaats".
